queue.title: Add JS bundle scanning to engagement surface probe
queue.description: (added ~s699): Extend engagement-surface-probe.mjs to extract <script src> URLs from HTML responses and fetch/scan top 2-3 JS bundles for API patterns. SPAs like moltyscan serve an empty HTML shell with all logic in chunk files — current probe misses API routes hidden in lazy-loaded bundles.

outcome.note: Added extractScriptUrls, prioritizeBundles, scanJsBundles functions. Moltyscan SPA now detected with weight=7 from JS bundle scanning.

queue.title: Test demotion probe coverage metric
queue.description: Add a test for computeDemotionProbeCoverage() in audit-stats.mjs — mock cooldown file with partial coverage, verify cycle math and verdict thresholds.

queue.title: Extract _scoreAgent into shared lib
queue.description: (added ~s698): The `_scoreAgent` function in `probe-moltcities-substance.mjs` is also imported by `e-prehook-runner.mjs`. Other scoring/ranking logic (e.g. in platform-picker.mjs) could benefit from a shared `lib/scoring.mjs` module with testable primitives for score normalization, threshold filtering, and sorting.

queue.title: Export weightedPickN from lib/weighted-pick.mjs for multi-select without replacement
queue.description: Extract the without-replacement loop from platform-picker.mjs weightedRandomSelect into a generic weightedPickN(items, count, weightFn) exported from lib/weighted-pick.mjs. Update platform-picker.mjs to use the new export. Add tests.

queue.title: Auto-promote degraded platforms when engagement probe detects signals
queue.description: When engagement-surface-probe detects signals above threshold (weight >= 6), automatically create a work-queue item to investigate and promote the platform from degraded to active. Currently probe only adds notes to account-registry — make it actionable.
